query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_SUPPLIERSCORECARD (SUPPLIERSCORECARD_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT SUPPLIERSCORECARD_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_SUPPLIERSCORECARD WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT SUPPLIERSCORECARD_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_SUPPLIERSCORECARD WHERE SUPPLIERSCORECARD_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_SUPPLIERSCORECARD SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SUPPLIERSCORECARD_ID = ?
